questions.question: What does Ezekiel 48 describe?
options: The full rebuilding of all of the ruined and broken cities
The division of the land among the twelve tribes
The long genealogy of all of the priestly families
The final great battle against all of the gathered nations
questions.answer: The division of the land among the twelve tribes
